changeSet.author: datarun
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision DROP CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_command

ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_command CHECK (command IN ('MIGRATION', 'GAP_REPAIR', 'UPLOAD', 'LEGACY_UPLOAD', 'HELD_RELEASE', 'ADMIN_DELETE', 'EDIT', 'MOVE', 'SPLIT', 'DELETE', 'RESTORE', 'CONFLICT_ACCEPT'))
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision DROP CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_on_behalf_of
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_on_behalf_of CHECK ((on_behalf_of_user_id IS NOT NULL) = (command IN ('HELD_RELEASE', 'CONFLICT_ACCEPT')))

rollback.sql: DO $$ BEGIN IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal.submission_revision WHERE command IN ('EDIT', 'MOVE', 'SPLIT', 'DELETE', 'RESTORE', 'CONFLICT_ACCEPT')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'journal.submission_revision holds revisions of submission review''s commands: never roll it back'; END IF; END $$
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision DROP CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_on_behalf_of
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_on_behalf_of CHECK ((on_behalf_of_user_id IS NOT NULL) = (command = 'HELD_RELEASE'))
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision DROP CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_command
ALTER TABLE journal.submission_revision ADD CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_command CHECK (command IN ('MIGRATION', 'GAP_REPAIR', 'UPLOAD', 'LEGACY_UPLOAD', 'HELD_RELEASE', 'ADMIN_DELETE'))
